resources.collectorBridge: One independent phase, same512MiB/16MiB/180s allocation, original finite source-plan limits but no HTTP operation installed
resources.estimatedTotalMinutes: 15-35; calibrate after first chunk; no unchanged replay
resources.checkpoint: Atomic compact progress after each completed row outside scratch; matching incomplete chunk resumes completed prefix
resources.placement: Retained compact outputs directly OneDrive; bounded active per-row JSON checkpoint in owned local scratch
resources.lowHeadroom: Only one row checkpoint lives at a time; resource supervisor automatically reduces the16MiB cap to available headroom above5GiB emergency reserve, with2MiB minimum for atomic checkpoint+staging. Exact minimum and incomplete scope recorded if indivisible row cannot fit; retain prefixes and continue independent safe work.
resources.cleanup: Registered resource supervisor finalizer stop/join owned group, verify absence/open files, remove scratch, release reservation and retain bounded progress/failure receipts; additionally remove only exact owned dependency symlink after group absence, verify vendor pins and record link absence
resources.dependencyLink: One owned symlink at032/server/node_modules; full139-file vendor tree is read-only and pinned; no archive/install/copy. Manifest before allocation, exact ownership removal after children stop, finally/termination finalizer and absence receipt.

reuse.validScope: Unchanged policy/signature/V2 components and retained admission/cache observations at historical code identity only. Does not credit old311 outcomes as current whole-pipeline passes. Exactly one old retained capture is selected for a new current collector bridge.
reuse.qualifiedImageTechnical: Retain exact existing qualified observations separately; no broadcast or bulk image/technical operation.

excluded: Source/network/provider traffic and broad source admission replay
Historical candidateV1 representation, existing image associations and exact supplement mutation
Corpus publication/active HTTP consumer proof (Mike proof12 owns it)
Full suite, native stock/current-run/orderUUID, F58/profile/WMI gaps and Story acceptance
authority: Preparation confers no execution authority. Exact new plan SHA, dependency identity, predecessor plan SHA and per-phase parent release required; original failed run retains no pass credit.

dependency.policy: Refuse an occupied link path. After child stop/join, unlink only the exact created symlink device/inode/target; never modify vendor, existing dependencies or installed environments.

retryOf.retryBasis: Static pg module-resolution failure before proof evaluation, original source replay or any enrichment row; fresh plan/grant/run identity, no successful work repeated.
